findings.message: cmdSalvarDadosEmpresa has no <command>.input state in the definition; added public cmdSalvarDadosEmpresaDraft with setCmdSalvarDadosEmpresaDraft. The docId entry param prefills its details.identification.docId.

Entry param empresaId (select:boasVindasEmpresa, persisted) has no state in the definition; added public state empresaId (persisted). The record itself is empresa, loaded by session, so no select method or getter was added.
cmdSalvarDadosEmpresa returns empresa and the note says no state has it as source; applied it to the state empresa (replace), the only state holding the company.
